notes.title: Time for Demo update!
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Hi Photographers![/b][/h1]

[b]Thank you for your feedback[/b]. We’re reading every message and making notes.
And so [b]we’ve made some fixes[/b] in the demo. Curious about what changed?

[h3][b]Demo changelog and patch fixes:[/b][/h3]
   🌍 Added support for 10 additional languages, making the game accessible to a wider audience.
    🔍 Enhanced navigation: Player rotation is now visible on the map, allowing for better orientation and exploration.
    📷 Unlocked camera: Unlock new camera options to capture every moment in stunning detail and unleash your creativity.
    🎯 Added extra missions for more exciting adventures and challenges.
    🖥️ GUI improvements for a smoother and more intuitive user experience.
    🔊 Audio updates to enhance immersion and atmosphere.
    🎬 Animation and AI fixes to improve overall gameplay realism.
    🛠️ Fixed issues where players would fall through the map, ensuring a seamless gaming experience.
    🔧 Plus various other fixes and small updates to optimize performance and stability.

Experience the ultimate photography adventure with these exciting new additions and improvements! 📸✨

If you have any [b]questions[/b] or simply want to [b]stay up to date[/b] - [b]join our Discord[/b] and become a part of [b]Madnetic Games Community[/b] family
